verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as broadcasting input to many panes or acting on many tabs or windows at once, are a fair axis for a terminal emulator. The evidence documents no such capability. The AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs and input events is only a developer building block from which bulk actions could be constructed, not a bulk-operation feature itself. The runtime probe also found no remote-control or IPC interface for driving a running instance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
